narrative:
Price and mix add ~2.1% to net sales on top of the volume plan. Premium built-in brands — Gaggenau, Thermador, Neff — carry the richest mix uplift (3.0–3.4%), while freestanding and entry fridge-freezers face price pressure from Chinese competitors.

In North America, tariff-driven competitor price increases create headroom for Thermador and Bosch Benchmark. In Europe, the shift from standalone hoods to venting induction hobs improves mix at constant volume.

Price elasticity is modelled in Snowflake on ACDOCA transaction history; the agreed price plan is written back to SAC so controllers no longer enter price assumptions by hand.

signals.title: US Tariff & Pricing Watch
signals.excerpt: Competitors raised US list prices 6–9% after tariff changes; BSH North America premium brands (Thermador, Bosch Benchmark) show low price elasticity.

signals.title: European Home Appliance Market Outlook
signals.excerpt: European MDA market flat to +1% in 2026 after two years of decline; premium built-in segment recovering faster than freestanding. China competition intensifying in entry price points.
